policies.text: An instrument receives standard hospital usage clearance provided it satisfies baseline manufacturing quality compliance.
A surgical device qualifies for master supply catalog placement when it achieves health network purchasing eligibility and retains active FDA clearance.
Execution of supply contracts is recommended for any medical device that qualifies for master supply catalog placement.
An unmanned aerial system obtains commercial operation clearance provided it maintains valid FAA commercial flight authorization.
A medical item attains health network purchasing eligibility if it holds standard hospital usage clearance and possesses product indemnity coverage of no less than $3,000,000.
An educational institution obtains elite accreditation status provided its student graduation rate exceeds 90 percent over five years.
A product achieves baseline manufacturing quality compliance when it demonstrates a material stress rating of at least 80 points alongside valid ISO 13485 quality certification status.
An office building receives a green facility designation if its annual energy consumption is under 150 kWh per square meter and it possesses a certified LEED badge.
